title: Monthly Close Checklist
description: A monthly-close checklist tracks the bookkeeping tasks required to close a client's books for one fiscal period, together with the open-items loop - the back-and-forth questions sent to the client (or internal staff) that must be resolved before the period can be closed.

engagementId.description: The engagement this close belongs to.

status.description: Overall state of the close. A close moves from not_started through in_progress and (optionally) review before being closed; reopened captures a period reopened after closing.

tasks.description: The individual close tasks (e.g. reconcile bank, reconcile credit cards, review AR, accruals, depreciation, tie-out).

openItems.description: The open-items loop: questions or requests raised during the close that block completion until resolved.

closedAt.description: When the period was closed. Present only when status is closed.

closeTask.description: A single unit of close work.

name.description: Task name, e.g. "Reconcile operating bank account".

openItemIds.description: Open items that block this task.

openItem.description: A question or request raised during the close that must be resolved before closing. The open-items loop is: open -> awaiting_response -> answered -> resolved (or wont_fix).

question.description: The question or request, e.g. "What is the $4,210 charge to Vendor X on 2026-05-12?".

directedTo.description: Who the item is directed at.
